name: Computer Use
description: Codex 风格的计算机使用插件：在授权后让代理直接控制本地屏幕（截图、点击、键入、按键）。配合 Tauri 桥接可在桌面端完整使用。

description_i18n.zh-CN: Codex 风格的计算机使用插件：在授权后让代理直接控制本地屏幕（截图、点击、键入、按键）。配合 Tauri 桥接可在桌面端完整使用。
description_i18n.en-US: Codex-style computer use plugin: lets the agent take over the local screen (screenshots, clicks, typing, hotkeys) once the user has granted permission. Pair with the Tauri bridge for the full desktop experience.

author: GE-paw

tools.name: computer_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current screen and return as a data URL.

tools.name: computer_click
tools.description: Click at screen coordinates (x, y) with optional button.

tools.name: computer_type
tools.description: Type the given text into the focused field.

tools.name: computer_key
tools.description: Press a single key or combination (e.g. Return, ctrl+l).
